title: Email: counsel — put the no-pay decision in writing

fields.subject: FW: Counsel — decision record and Friday threat
fields.note: Marguerite — counsel’s note below, via SecureWatch. — Tomás

original.subject: Decision record
original.body:
Please have the General Manager record the decision not to pay, with the reasons, in the incident record today.

The FBI field office has the report.

Note that the actor’s README threatens to publish the copied data on Friday if no contact is made. Clients whose data may be affected should hear that from us, not from the actor.

instructorNote: Watch for the written decision and the clients told about the publication threat.

snapshot.title: Recovery Order Confirmation — Final Verification

fields.subject: Recovery Order Confirmation - Final Verification
fields.note: The recovery order has been fully executed and verified under HUOG-ISP Section 9.3. All data has been restored in the correct sequence and validated against its manifest before processing. No system has been reconnected to the network without verification. The environment is clean and operational.
fields.signature:
Systems & Cybersecurity Lead
Harwick UAS Operations Group

original.subject: Recovery Order Confirmation - Final Verification
original.body:
The recovery order has been followed:
1. Calibration share verified and restored (OB-1).
2. Ops records (flight logs, link logs, DAA-1 recordings) restored and verified.
3. CP&L Campaign D-3 processed under manifest verification.
4. Remaining campaigns restored in order.

All restored data has been verified against its manifest before any processing. No data was used without verification. The environment is clean. Recovery is complete.

snapshot.instructorNote: This inject confirms the successful completion of the recovery order. The IC and GM must now validate that all steps were followed and that client data is ready for delivery. Watch for any attempt to bypass verification or proceed without formal approval.
